summary: No new record update is submitted this turn because nothing new has been executed yet; the last validated update, the snapshot-resynchronization interpretation, remains the submission and is already retained. This turn prepared, but deliberately did not submit, a test for the one authority-transition option the audit has not exercised: with StepDownOnRemoval enabled, a follower proposes the removal of the current leader, the leader must step down rather than keep leading a configuration it is no longer part of, the remaining voters must elect a new leader with the clock running, and the group must keep committing afterwards. That test has not been compiled or run, so it carries no evidence status and no claim rests on it; it will be verified locally before anything is submitted from it, and if it does not compile or run cleanly the harness will be reverted so the retained artifacts stay exactly as they were. The audit record itself is unchanged: one asserted defect with ten receipts and five independent controls, two bounded safety negatives, two resynchronization branches, a read-index boundary control, and per-question limitations stating what is witnessed, what is bounded and what was deliberately not sampled.
